about: Known truths for tools/exam.py. A case is an area (lat, lon, km) and a time (UTC). truth: post (at least one post, by post_by if given), one_post (exactly one post there), no_post, or open (not settled: shown, never scored). sure: sure / likely. Add a case only from a review in docs/reviews.

cases.note: One burning ship off Khasab, posted six times as a new fire. An independent analyst put one source at 90%.
Heat at sea from 22:00 Baghdad; NASA 3.2 and 3.7 MW at 01:10. US Central Command said it disabled the ship Pacific Archer that day. Never posted that night.
Heat again from 17:50 Baghdad, posted at 18:30, a first sighting again at 23:00. The IRGC navy said a tanker hit a mine at the mouth of Khasab port that evening: one fire or two is not settled.

cases.review: summary of 26 Nov in this session
cases.note: Two 1.1 MW NASA pixels of one night pass in the Persian Gulf: most likely a platform's small flare that no map holds. Posted because two pixels of one pass counted as two sightings.
Posted at 01:30 Baghdad. Read as likely cloud or fog; the announced strike was elsewhere. Not settled.
A 64 MW blaze at a well site in the Jafurah gas field: real heat, rightly posted.
